points.description: Vertex positions as array of [x, y, z] triples

faceVertexIndices.description: Triangle vertex indices into the points array

normals.description: Optional vertex normals as array of [nx, ny, nz] triples

uvs.description: Optional UV coordinates as array of [u, v] pairs

derivedFrom.description: Higher tier this mesh was derived from, if any. Absent means authored.

tolerance.description: Tessellation tolerance in source units, if derived

sourceHash.description: Stable content hash of the source-tier record. Lets consumers detect cache staleness.

faceGroups.description: Triangle-range → source-face mapping, emitted by Tier B tessellation.

description: Tier M entry. Triangulated mesh for rendering. May be authored or derived.

faceIndex.description: Position of the face in the assembled Brep (in-memory compile order).

faceName.description:
Stable name of the source face child node (e.g. "Face_3"); the durable
correlation key a renderer uses to find the face node's own attributes.

MeshFaceGroup.description:
Maps a contiguous slice of faceVertexIndices back to its source Brep face.
Emitted by Brep (Level 2) tessellation; lets renderers apply per-face
materials authored on the composed face child node (e.g. `bodyPath/Face_3`).
